newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS AND BAT FIRST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS AND BAT FIRST.

text.p: Indian captain Sachin Tendulkar won the toss and chose to bat first against South Africa in the day/night final of the triangular series at Kingsmead on Wednesday.
South Africa: Gary Kirsten, Andrew Hudson, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Allan Donald.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad.
